Russian Scholarship Project 2021-22 is an initiative from graduate students. The scholarship aims to award the deserving candidates by offering tuition fee benefits for the Master’s program at one of the top universities in Russia.
To be eligible, an applicant must:

Be willing to pursue Master’s in Computer & Data Science, Biology, Business & Management, Politics & International Relations, Mathematics & Artificial Intelligence, Psychology, Linguistics & Modern Languages, Physics, Chemistry, Economics, and Engineering & Technology
100 % discount on tuition fees will be offered to the selected students.
All research papers, certificates, awards and honours

The selection will be based on the evaluation of the portfolio submitted by the applicants.
The selected students will have to confirm their proficiency in English or Russian language.
The complete tuition fees of the selected students will be paid by the Russian Federation.
The candidates will be enrolled in the selected specialization as indicated in the application form.
The recipients of the scholarship will have to pay for their travel, accommodation costs, insurance, and personal expenses.
